notes.title: Even more little fixes!
notes.content:
- Leaderboards should be in the right order now
- Normal/Hard leaderboards should be correct instead of swapped
- Fix a bug where Beeder doesn't destroy its vine in 2-5
- Fix a bug where Rascal's key can stop working in 6-2
- Prevent keys from getting unreachably stuck in locked doors
- Fix a bug where any% time overwrites 100% time in levels you've already completed 100%
- Probably fix a bug where mashing gamepad makes the mouse UI flash (but I can't find my XBox controller, so, not totally sure about that one) (kind of a shoestring operation over here) (sorry)
- Some people are reporting problems with the Mac executable--I'm looking into that one

Thanks to speedrunner @callumbal for flagging these! You can check out @callumbal's WR speedruns of Normal and Hard here: https://www.speedrun.com/witcheye#Any

notes.title: Minor fixes for the new year
notes.content:
Having just found out about the Steam Discussions tab, I went ahead and fixed a few issues people brought up (in some cases months ago--sorry!)

- Can switch between fullscreen and windowed modes (hit Alt-Enter)
- "Be Quick or Be Dead" achievement should actually register
- Cursed Cauldron should come to life consistently
- Hopefully didn't break anything! :)

Thanks for your patience--please enjoy!
